data.description: 【铃兰 · 奉茶】古朴雅致的和室茶席前，身着传统小和服的丽萨端正地跪坐在草席上，神情极其认真地用小木勺舀起抹茶粉，双手稳稳端起茶盏向你躬身奉上——「博士请用茶。妈妈教导过我，无论身处何地，都要用心对待身边每一个重要的人。」
data.promptProse: Kneeling neatly on the tea room's straw mat, Suzuran prepares matcha with a small wooden spoon, then bows and presents the finished tea bowl in both hands. Her traditional small kimono folds over her knees in medium view. The veranda opening lies beside her, with the screen frame farther back. Soft afternoon light illuminates the bowl rim and rising steam, darkening gently beneath her sleeves.
data.title: 铃兰 · 奉茶
